ellen.wong: Auditor asked for a short reproducible export for RBAC change, KMS rotation, and vuln->incident. Keep it minimal so they can run it end-to-end.

audit-bot: I can prefill target S3 prefixes if owners confirm.

mike.hart: I'll do RBAC sample. Steps I run: 1) collect PR + approvals (link in ticket), 2) terraform plan JSON, 3) CloudTrail IAM slice, 4) k8s rolebinding snapshot. Commands: `terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform show -json tfplan > /tmp/tfplan.json`; `aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" --filter-pattern "AttachRolePolicy|PutRolePolicy" --start-time 1700000000000 --end-time 1700000360000 > /tmp/iam_events.json`; `kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -o yaml --all-namespaces > /tmp/rolebindings.yaml`. Upload layout: `s3://audit-exports/rbac/{ticket}/{ts}/` with `manifest.txt` (sha256 lines) and `manifest.txt.asc` (GPG). Maps: SOC2 CC6.1, ISO A.9.2.3.

sara.lee: I'll take KMS and incident. KMS commands (AWS): `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-data > /tmp/key_meta.json`; `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/prod-data --policy-name default > /tmp/key_policy.json`; CloudTrail slice for key events to `/tmp/kms_events.json`. Upload to `s3://audit-exports/kms/{alias}/{ts}/` and encrypt bundle with CMK; include key_arn in manifest. Maps: SOC2 CC6.2, ISO A.10.1.

sara.lee: Incident exports: ticket JSON, CI artifact sha (`sha256sum`), deploy trace, alert snapshot, redacted slack transcript. Upload to `s3://audit-exports/incidents/{ticket}/{ts}/`. Maps: SOC2 CC7.1, ISO A.16.1.3.

auditor.bryan: How do you prove immutability and chain-of-custody?

mike.hart: Each uploader runs `sha256sum` -> `manifest.txt`, signs `manifest.txt` with GPG, CI job ID and uploader recorded in S3 object metadata; finalized bundles get S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) and archival to Glacier-Deep for 7 years. Raw slack transcripts are quarantined; only redacted copy included.

auditor.bryan: Perfect. Please attach one sample RBAC bundle and one KMS bundle to AUD-2026-620 and list the exact S3 keys in the ticket so I can verify sha256 + `gpg --verify`.

audit-bot: Created task AUD-2026-620 and scheduled verification window 2026-04-12T09:00UTC.

ellen.wong: Will push sample bundles and README to the compliance repo and link the ticket by EOD.
